📦 Direct Warranty Issue to Engineer

Part ordered from Canon under warranty — issuing directly to engineer (not going through office stock). Will auto-complete when engineer closes the call.

ℹ️ Only digits after last / will be used as tracking key (e.g. 123456)

🛡️ Customer Claims Warranty

Customer has shown warranty proof on site. WC/Admin will be notified via Telegram & Email to approve.

🔄 Warranty Part Received

Part received back from company — will be added to Office stock.

↩️ Engineer Returns Parts

Engineer returns unused parts to office — subtracted from engineer, added to Office stock.

📥 Parts Request (Receive)

Submit a request — type part code/name and select. Parts will be added to your stock after Admin approval.
